nordkalottleden-kalottireitti-01-kilpisj.overviewStatus: selected as first section from Reisa/Käsivarsi official 12-leg model
interimFindings: Official Reisa model lists Kilpisjärvi-Saarijärvi as section 1 with distance 11 km.
Official/near-official Metsähallitus and Eräluvat sources describe Saarijärvi as about 12 km from Kilpisjärvi village/Visitor Centre, likely a reference-point/rounding difference.
Metsähallitus announced on 2025-06-24 that the former south-side Saana summer route was removed from summer use and Kalottireitti is routed north of Saana; older GPX/map linework may be stale.
Best official Saarijärvi hut-cluster coordinates from received report: new open wilderness hut 69.065017, 21.088950 and Saarijärvi Kiiruna reservable hut 69.065450, 21.086850.
Transit report identifies Kilpisjärven luontotalo P/E bus stops at about 0.08-0.18 km from the start; networks/operators include Eskelisen Lapin Linjat, Matkahuolto and Fintraffic GTFS.
Transit report confirms no scheduled motorized access to Saarijärvi hut area; nearest practical scheduled access is by walking/backtracking to Kilpisjärvi Nature Centre, about 11 trail km.
Rules report says the main stage should inherit Käsivarsi Wilderness Reserve rules; Malla Strict Nature Reserve rules apply only to western/Malla alternate or connector modeling.
Saarijärvi hut-specific rules: yard tenting allowed, no outdoor fire unless an official fire site is separately verified, hut firewood only for hut heating, no waste bins, natural water untreated.
Dogs/pets must be leashed in Käsivarsi, but Saarijärvi Kiiruna reservable hut prohibits pets; keep trail dog rule and hut lodging rule separate.
No official stage-1 closure found in the rules/safety pass. Current notices on Saarijärvi Kiiruna were administrative/booking-related rather than trail closures.

Facilities report identifies Kilpisjärvi Visitor Centre and parking as high-confidence start access metadata, and K-Market/Neste Kilpisjärvi as nearby resupply/service metadata rather than core route facilities.
Tsahkaljärvi lean-to/fire/toilet cluster is promising but pending because public/free versus rental/private elements are unclear.

Saarijärvi new open wilderness hut and Kiiruna/Naali reservable hut are high-confidence facilities, but exact coordinate choice needs final official GIS or field validation due stale/duplicate OSM hut nodes.
Do not import a Saarijärvi fireplace unless an official outdoor fire site is independently verified.

Recent field reports generally call the stage easy to follow but rockier/wetter than the distance suggests, with orange-tipped low poles, exposed wind, limited rocky tent sites around Saarijärvi, and no stage-specific closure found.

Hikeouts 2024 reports Kilpisjärvi-Saarijärvi as 18 km, but the same report's hut table gives Kilpis camping/hotel to Saarijärvi as 11.8 km; treat 18 km as access/logistics-inclusive, not official section distance.
remainingQuestions: Confirm whether the official 11 km section should use Kilpisjärvi Visitor Centre parking as the endpoint or another village access point.
Resolve why E1 Saarijärvi-Kilpisjärvi GPX measures about 18.4 km while Reisa and Luontoon list Kilpisjärvi-Saarijärvi as 11 km.
Confirm whether Luontoon route-map linework can be extracted as official geometry or only treated as map evidence.
Verify current bus stop naming/coordinates for the Kilpisjärvi start and the closest public access point for Saarijärvi.

agentBatches.notes: Overview synthesis is written to README.md and trail.research.json. The overview found strong trail identity but no single clean whole-trail official section inventory.
Six independent section agents are researching the same first section: official Reisa/Käsivarsi stage 1, Kilpisjärvi to Saarijärvi.

geometrySources.notes: E1 Hiking Europe has a Saarijärvi-Kilpisjärvi GPX measured locally at about 18.4 km from 729 points, but this conflicts with the official 11 km Luontoon/Reisa stage. Luontoon has official map/route content, but no standalone GPX/KML/GeoJSON extraction has been confirmed yet.

currentnessSources.notes: Luontoon currentness cards from 2025 flag late snow/high-water risks and recommend Kalottireitti from July. Eräluvat Saarijärvi page has 2026 booking/service notices and hut details.

knownGaps: No single official source found with a complete end-to-end one-row-per-day-stage Nordkalottleden inventory from Kautokeino to all southern variants.

The first section has a major geometry/distance split: official Luontoon/Reisa stage is Kilpisjärvi-Saarijärvi 11 km, while the E1 Saarijärvi-Kilpisjärvi GPX includes a longer 18.4 km approach/variant ending away from the Luontoon Visitor Centre start.
The closest public transit/access point for Saarijärvi is likely back in Kilpisjärvi, roughly 11-12 km by trail; no road or public transit reaches the hut.
